page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.g7t.8xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across most metrics. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1881.88, while the multi-core score reaches 31066.84. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1694.85 GB/sec, dropping to 153.13 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, with a large block write speed of 68.53 GB/sec. In database operations, the instance achieves a PassMark database score of 14602.57 and processes 31.19 million Redis SET operations per second. For LLM inference using a small 135M model, text generation performance is a highlight, reaching 305.55 tokens/second, which falls into the strong performance category.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-intensive workloads. However, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power without resource contention. The instance is configured for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations. It can also handle light machine learning tasks, such as text generation with smaller models, but is not designed for heavy parallel computing or large-scale LLM inference due to the absence of hardware accelerators.
